content.instruction: Email Dana to let her know that the meeting has been moved to Thursday. Confirm with the user before sending the email.
content.context: The user's full utterance was: "email dana that the meeting moved to thursday and then check if room four b is free." Only the email to Dana is part of this task; the room 4B availability check is a separate request and is not included here.
constraints: This task acts on the outside world, so the agent must confirm with the user before sending the email.
Do not add details the user did not provide, such as a specific date, time, location, or reason for the move.
Send the email only to Dana.
success_criteria: The user has been asked to confirm the email before it is sent.
An email is sent to Dana stating that the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
open_questions: Which Thursday (specific date) is the meeting moved to?
Should the email include the meeting time or any other details, and if so, what are they?
What subject line should the email use?
